changelog:
Business Document Generator Skill v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launches a skill for generating professional business documents using customizable templates.
- Supports creation of proposals, quotes, invoices, contracts, business letters, and reports.
- Includes industry-specific defaults for tone and formatting (e.g., corporate, tech, creative, legal, non-profit, real estate).
- Features a structured document generation flow: identifies document type, collects variables, applies templates, and outputs ready-to-use documents.
- Provides a comprehensive template library covering common business document needs.
summary: Generate polished, customizable business documents including proposals, quotes, invoices, contracts, and letters tailored to your industry and needs.
